usedFor: Follow Up Boss holds appointments, and Conversion Chats messages them when “New Appointment Is Created” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment Is Created” in Follow Up Boss, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new appointment sends a template message through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “Contact Is Updated” can fire repeatedly for one contact, so “Send Template Message” may go out more than once.
